title: Roveia sideways services track
description: A row of soft grey cards with 24px corners: illustration on top, a 32px light title, small hairline chips and a tagline. On desktop the section pins for about three windows and the row slides sideways with the scroll; the card in focus takes a pale blue tint and its illustration turns from grey to colour. Phones stack the cards.
notes: desktop: 380svh tall with the row pinned; phones: content height
one illustration slot per card (306×240 on phones, 324×256 on desktop)
the focused card is by position in the run (first at the start, last at the end)
without scroll-driven animations the row scrolls sideways by hand
name: roveia-services
